name: sketchflow
description: Modern SketchFlow canvas with real-time collaboration using React, TypeScript, and WebSocket

scripts.build: pnpm prepare:workspace && pnpm --filter @sketchflow/client build && pnpm --filter @sketchflow/server build
scripts.test: pnpm prepare:workspace && pnpm --filter @sketchflow/client test && pnpm --filter @sketchflow/server test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm prepare:workspace && pnpm --filter @sketchflow/client test:coverage && pnpm --filter @sketchflow/server test:coverage
scripts.type-check: pnpm prepare:workspace && pnpm --filter @sketchflow/client type-check && pnpm --filter @sketchflow/server build
scripts.check:client-budgets: pnpm prepare:workspace && pnpm --filter @sketchflow/client build && node scripts/check-client-budgets.mjs
